<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>TRQYOS — the desktop assistant</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap">
<style>
:root{--bg:#eef3fb;--fg:#0b1530;--dim:#46567c;--acc:#1a4fd6;--on:#fff;--line:rgba(11,21,48,.22);--card:rgba(238,243,251,.84);--vig:rgba(190,205,235,.8);--r0:#a9bde8;--r1:#0a2a8a;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#010309;--fg:#e6efff;--dim:#8ea3cf;--acc:#4aa6ff;--on:#010309;--line:rgba(147,209,255,.24);--card:rgba(2,6,18,.76);--vig:rgba(0,0,0,.65);--r0:#0e2a66;--r1:#ffffff}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#010309;--fg:#e6efff;--dim:#8ea3cf;--acc:#4aa6ff;--on:#010309;--line:rgba(147,209,255,.24);--card:rgba(2,6,18,.76);--vig:rgba(0,0,0,.65);--r0:#0e2a66;--r1:#ffffff}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--bg)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font:400 15px/1.7 "JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;overflow-x:hidden}
#c{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;touch-action:pan-y;z-index:0}
.vig{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;background:radial-gradient(125% 95% at 50% 50%,transparent 50%,var(--vig) 100%)}
main{position:relative;z-index:2;pointer-events:none}
main :is(a,button,.term,details,.row,li,summary){pointer-events:auto}
.wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-top:22px;padding-bottom:10px}
.logo{font-weight:700;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.nav nav{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.lnk{background:none;border:0;padding:6px 10px;color:var(--dim)}
.lnk:hover{color:var(--fg)}
.btn{font-weight:700;padding:12px 20px;border:1px solid var(--acc);background:var(--acc);color:var(--on)}
.btn.ghost{background:var(--card);color:var(--acc)}
.btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--acc);outline-offset:3px}
.hero{min-height:calc(100svh - 70px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding-top:40px;padding-bottom:56px}
.hero>*{max-width:560px}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.5rem,7.2vw,4.9rem);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.045em;margin:0 0 24px;font-weight:700}
.lead{color:var(--dim);margin:0 0 30px;font-size:16px}
.cta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.meta{margin-top:22px;color:var(--dim);font-size:13px}
.live{display:inline-block;width:.6em;height:.6em;background:var(--acc);margin-right:8px;animation:bl 1.4s steps(1) infinite}
@keyframes bl{50%{opacity:0}}
.hint{margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--dim)}
section{padding:72px 0}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.6rem,4vw,2.6rem);letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 14px;max-width:700px}
.sub{color:var(--dim);max-width:600px;margin:0 0 36px}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.1fr);gap:8px 32px;padding:20px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--card),transparent 85%)}
.row code{color:var(--acc);font:700 15px/1.5 inherit}
.row code::before{content:"> ";color:var(--dim);font-weight:400}
.row p{margin:0;color:var(--dim)}
.term{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);max-width:780px;margin-bottom:40px}
.term .h{padding:8px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--dim);font-size:12px}
.term .b{padding:20px 16px;min-height:132px}
.q b{color:var(--acc)}
.cur{display:inline-block;width:.6em;height:1.1em;background:var(--acc);vertical-align:-.2em;animation:bl 1s steps(1) infinite}
.a{margin-top:10px;color:var(--dim)}
ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:16px;counter-reset:s}
ol li{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);padding:20px}
ol li::before{counter-increment:s;content:"step " counter(s);color:var(--acc);display:block;margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:700}
ol li b{display:block;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:17px}
ol li span{color:var(--dim)}
.pv{max-width:640px;padding:28px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);pointer-events:auto}
.pv p{margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--dim)}
.pv p:last-child{margin:0}
.pv strong{color:var(--fg)}
details{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px 0;max-width:760px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--card),transparent 90%)}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;list-style:none}
summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
summary::before{content:"+ ";color:var(--acc)}
details[open] summary::before{content:"\2212  "}
details p{margin:10px 0 0;color:var(--dim)}
footer{padding:48px 0 64px;color:var(--dim);font-size:13px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translate(-50%,16px);background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg);padding:10px 16px;font-size:13px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s;z-index:5;pointer-events:none;max-width:90vw}
.toast.on{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media (max-width:760px){.row{grid-template-columns:1fr}.nav nav .lnk{display:none}.hero{justify-content:flex-start;padding-top:28px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.live,.cur{animation:none}}
/* ---- gallery: asymmetric grid, bar + window left, tall panel right ---- */
.gal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.72fr 1fr;gap:22px;align-items:start}
.shot{margin:0;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);overflow:hidden;transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-color .6s ease,box-shadow .6s ease}
.shot:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--acc);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(3,8,24,.55)}
.shot.tall{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/span 2}
.shot .ph{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#04070f}
.shot .ph::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 55%,rgba(4,7,15,.45));pointer-events:none}
.shot img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;transition:transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.shot:hover img{transform:scale(1.03)}
.shot img.ld{animation:imgin 1.1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) backwards}
@keyframes imgin{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.06)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
.shot figcaption{padding:16px 18px 18px;color:var(--dim);font-size:13px;line-height:1.65}
.shot figcaption b{display:block;color:var(--fg);font-size:15px;margin-bottom:6px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
@media (max-width:760px){.gal{grid-template-columns:1fr}.shot.tall{grid-column:auto;grid-row:auto}}

/* ---- smooth reveal on scroll ---- */
html{scroll-padding-top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 76px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
.rv{opacity:0}
.rv.in{opacity:1;animation:rv .85s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) backwards;animation-delay:var(--d,0s)}
@keyframes rv{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* ---- reading progress + sticky nav ---- */
#pb{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:2px;width:0;background:var(--acc);z-index:6;pointer-events:none}
.nav{display:block;padding:0;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:4;background:var(--card);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 80%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:border-color .4s ease}
.nav.sc{border-bottom-color:var(--line)}
.nin{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-top:16px;padding-bottom:12px}

/* ---- micro-interactions ---- */
.btn{transition:filter .3s ease,transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .4s ease}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px -16px color-mix(in srgb,var(--acc) 65%,transparent)}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(0);box-shadow:none}
.lnk{border-radius:4px;transition:color .3s ease,background .3s ease}
.lnk:hover{background:var(--card)}
.term{transition:border-color .5s ease}
.term:hover{border-color:var(--acc)}
ol li{transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-color .5s ease}
ol li:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--acc)}
.pv{transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-color .5s ease}
.pv:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--acc)}
summary{transition:color .3s ease}
summary:hover{color:var(--acc)}
details[open] p{animation:rv .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) backwards}
.row{position:relative}
.row::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:-1px;height:1px;width:0;background:var(--acc);transition:width .65s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.row:hover::after{width:100%}

/* ---- calm mode ---- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.rv{opacity:1}.rv.in{animation:none}.btn:hover{transform:none;box-shadow:none}.shot{transition:none}.shot:hover{transform:none}.shot img{transition:none}.shot:hover img{transform:none}.shot img.ld{animation:none}ol li{transition:none}ol li:hover{transform:none}.pv{transition:none}.pv:hover{transform:none}}
</style>
<noscript><style>.rv{opacity:1}</style></noscript>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
<div class="vig"></div>
<div id="pb"></div>
<main>
<header class="nav"><div class="wrap nin">
  <div class="logo">TRQYOS</div>
  <nav>
    <button class="lnk" data-go="what">What it does</button>
    <button class="lnk" data-go="how">How it works</button>
    <button class="lnk" data-go="gallery">Gallery</button>
    <button class="lnk" data-go="privacy">Privacy</button>
    <button class="lnk" data-go="faq">FAQ</button>
    <button class="btn" data-dl>Get the beta</button>
  </nav>
</div></header>

<div class="wrap hero">
  <h1 class="rv">Less busywork.<br>More control.</h1>
  <p class="lead rv">TRQYOS is a desktop assistant built to help you get things done from one place. Ask for help with everyday tasks, work with files, or use the tools available in your setup—without having to remember a command for everything.</p>
  <div class="cta rv">
    <button class="btn" data-dl>Download the beta</button>
    <button class="btn ghost" data-go="how">See how it works</button>
  </div>
  <div class="meta rv"><span class="live"></span>Open Troy when you need it with the configured keyboard shortcut.</div>
  <div class="hint rv">A personal desktop assistant, built to be extended.
  </div>
</div>

<section id="what"><div class="wrap">
  <h2 class="rv">Spend less time on repetitive tasks.</h2>
  <p class="sub rv">Use everyday language to describe what you want. These examples show the kinds of requests a desktop assistant can help with; what works depends on your current setup and enabled tools.</p>
  <div class="row rv"><code>open the invoice from Tuesday</code><p>Ask to open a file, app or folder. The result depends on which search and launch tools are configured.</p></div>
  <div class="row rv"><code>rename these 48 photos by date</code><p>For file operations, review the available actions and confirm changes before running them. Preview and undo support depend on the tool being used.</p></div>
  <div class="row rv"><code>summarize this PDF in 5 bullets</code><p>If a compatible model and document-reading tool are configured, ask for a summary and check the source document for details.</p></div>
  <div class="row rv"><code>quiet mode until 3pm</code><p>This kind of focus mode requires notification controls and a timer to be configured. Availability varies by operating system and connected tools.</p></div>
  <div class="row rv"><code>what did I copy this morning?</code><p>Clipboard search requires clipboard-history support to be enabled. Check its settings before storing anything sensitive.</p></div>
  <div class="row rv"><code>every Friday, zip my Downloads</code><p>Scheduled tasks and hotkeys can automate supported actions when those features are configured.</p></div>
</div></section>

<section id="how"><div class="wrap">
  <h2 class="rv">Open it. Ask. Take action.</h2>
  <p class="sub rv">Keep your workflow simple: open Troy, describe the task, and review the available response or action.</p>
  <div class="term rv" role="img" aria-label="Animated example of typing requests into TRQYOS">
    <div class="h">trqyos prompt</div>
    <div class="b"><div class="q"><b>&gt;</b> <span id="qq"></span><i class="cur"></i></div><div class="a" id="aa"></div></div>
  </div>
  <ol>
    <li class="rv"><b>Summon</b><span>Open the assistant using the shortcut configured in your build. The exact behaviour depends on your desktop setup.</span></li>
    <li class="rv"><b>Ask</b><span>Describe what you need in plain language. Voice input is available only if it is enabled in your build.</span></li>
    <li class="rv"><b>Confirm</b><span>Review file-changing actions before confirming them. Preview and undo options depend on the specific tool and action.</span></li>
  </ol>
</div></section>

<section id="gallery"><div class="wrap">
  <h2 class="rv">Troy, at a glance</h2>
  <p class="sub rv">A closer look at the desktop assistant</p>
  <div class="gal">
    <figure class="shot rv"><div class="ph"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="The TRQYOS mini bar: Troy's avatar, a Ready status and an Ask me anything input in a slim floating pill" loading="lazy"></div><figcaption><b>Compact desktop widget</b> A compact widget concept for opening Troy and sending a request from the desktop.</figcaption></figure>
    <figure class="shot rv"><div class="ph"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="The full TRQYOS window with a sidebar of Chat, Memory, Tools, Tasks, Logs and Settings, showing a live system status answer" loading="lazy"></div><figcaption><b>The main workspace</b> A single workspace for the features available in your current build.</figcaption></figure>
    <figure class="shot tall rv"><div class="ph"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="A narrow docked TRQYOS panel showing the same system status conversation above a message input" loading="lazy">Remote access depends on the companion service and network configuration being set up.</div><figcaption><b>Mobile access</figcaption></figure>
  </div>
</div></section>

<section id="privacy"><div class="wrap">
  <h2 class="rv">Your setup. Your choices.</h2>
  <div class="pv rv">
    <p>TRQYOS is designed as a desktop assistant. Where files, logs and other data are stored depends on your configuration; check your build and settings before using sensitive information.</p>
    <p><strong>No account required by this page.</strong> Installation and setup depend on the build you use.</p>
    <p><strong>Local options may be available.</strong> Some actions may work locally, while model responses or connected services may require an internet connection. Exact offline support depends on your configuration.</p>
    <p><strong>Know what uses a connection.</strong> If you use an online model or external service, review its settings and privacy terms to understand what data may be sent.</p>
  </div>
</div></section>

<section id="faq"><div class="wrap">
  <h2 class="rv">Questions, answered.</h2>
  <p class="sub rv">A few things to know before getting started.</p>
  <details class="rv"><summary>Does TRQYOS work offline?</summary><p>Some features can run locally, but this depends on the tools and model you have configured. Online models and web lookups require a connection.</p></details>
  <details class="rv"><summary>Can it damage my files?</summary><p>Safety checks vary by tool. Review an action before confirming it, and keep a backup of important files; not every action can be undone.</p></details>
  <details class="rv"><summary>Which apps can it control?</summary><p>App control depends on the tools and integrations available in your build. Check the project documentation before assuming a particular app or service is supported.</p></details>
  <details class="rv"><summary>Which systems does it run on?</summary><p>The supported operating systems depend on the build you are using. Check the release notes for current platform support and shortcut details.</p></details>
  <details class="rv"><summary>Is it free?</summary><p>The price and licence depend on the project release. Check the repository or release page for the current terms.</p></details>
</div></section>

<section><div class="wrap">
  <h2 class="rv">Ready when you are.</h2>
  <p class="sub rv">Ready to try TRQYOS? Use the download link for your actual build, then follow its setup instructions.</p>
  <div class="cta rv"><button class="btn" data-dl>Download the beta</button><button class="btn ghost" data-go="what">Read what it does</button></div>
</div></section>

<footer><div class="wrap">TRQYOS is a desktop assistant project. © 2026 TRQYOS.</div></footer>
</main>
<div class="toast" id="toast" role="status"></div>

<script>
(()=>{
'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const cv=$('c'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const RM=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v;
const GL=' .\u00b7:;-=+*x%#',NB=11,TAU=Math.PI*2;
let W,H,dpr,fs,cw,ch,cols,rows,zb,gi,bk,pal=[],bg=null,act=[];

/* theme: glyph ramp is read from CSS tokens so it follows light/dark */
const hex=s=>{s=s.trim().replace('#','');return[0,2,4].map(i=>parseInt(s.substr(i,2),16))};
function theme(){
  const cs=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement),a=hex(cs.getPropertyValue('--r0')),b=hex(cs.getPropertyValue('--r1'));
  pal=[];for(let i=0;i<=NB;i++){const f=i/NB;pal.push('rgb('+a.map((v,k)=>Math.round(v+(b[k]-v)*f)).join(',')+')')}
  buildBg();
}
function buildBg(){
  bg=document.createElement('canvas');bg.width=cv.width;bg.height=cv.height;
  const g=bg.getContext('2d');g.scale(dpr,dpr);g.font=fs+'px "JetBrains Mono",monospace';g.textAlign='center';g.textBaseline='middle';
  g.fillStyle=pal[2];g.globalAlpha=.55;
  for(let y=1;y<rows;y+=3)for(let x=1;x<cols;x+=4)g.fillText('+',(x+.5)*cw,(y+.5)*ch);
}
function layout(){
  dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;
  cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr;
  fs=W<700?11:W<1300?13:15;
  ctx.font=fs+'px "JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace';
  cw=ctx.measureText('M').width||fs*.6;ch=fs*1.3;
  cols=Math.ceil(W/cw);rows=Math.ceil(H/ch);
  zb=new Float32Array(cols*rows).fill(-9);gi=new Float32Array(cols*rows);bk=new Uint8Array(cols*rows);act=[];
  if(pal.length)buildBg();
  docH=document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
}

/* the core: a rounded octahedral crystal ringed by two tilted, segmented orbits */
const CORE=[],N=1000,GA=Math.PI*(3-Math.sqrt(5));
for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
  const y=1-2*(i+.5)/N,r=Math.sqrt(1-y*y),a=i*GA,x=Math.cos(a)*r,z=Math.sin(a)*r;
  const s=1/(1+.6*(Math.abs(x)+Math.abs(y)+Math.abs(z)-1));
  CORE.push([x,y,z,s]);
}
const RINGS=[{R:1.55,tx:.55,tz:0,sp:.5,n:150},{R:1.85,tx:-.3,tz:.9,sp:-.35,n:170}];
const L=[-.5,.6,.65];
let yaw=.6,pit=.35,vy=0,vp=0,drag=false,lx=0,ly=0,trav=0,t=0,pulses=[],nextAuto=1;
let cx,cy,u,sw,scL=0,docH=1;

function plot(x,y,z,b,ex){
  const cyw=Math.cos(sw),syw=Math.sin(sw),cp=Math.cos(pit),sp=Math.sin(pit);
  // yaw then pitch
  const x1=x*cyw+z*syw,z1=-x*syw+z*cyw,y2=y*cp-z1*sp,z2=y*sp+z1*cp;
  const s=6/(6-z2),px=cx+x1*u*s,py=cy-y2*u*s;
  for(const p of pulses){
    const d=Math.hypot(px-p.x,py-p.y),w=u*.3,e=(d-p.R)/w;
    b+=1.1*p.f*Math.exp(-e*e);
  }
  const c=Math.floor(px/cw),r=Math.floor(py/ch);
  if(c<0||r<0||c>=cols||r>=rows)return;
  const i=r*cols+c;
  if(z2>zb[i]){if(zb[i]<-8)act.push(i);zb[i]=z2;gi[i]=ex?b:b+.1*Math.sin(y2*9-t*2.5)}
  return [x1,y2,z2];
}
function frame(now){
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  const dt=Math.min((now-(frame.l||now))/1000,.05);frame.l=now;t+=dt;
  if(!drag){
    yaw+=(RM?0:.28*dt)+vy*dt;pit=clamp(pit+vp*dt+(.3-pit)*Math.min(1,dt*.6),-1.2,1.2);
    const k=Math.pow(.04,dt);vy*=k;vp*=k;
  }
  scL+=(scrollY-scL)*(RM?1:Math.min(1,dt*7));
  const sc=scL,alpha=1-clamp(sc/H,0,1)*.65;
  sw=yaw+sc*.004;
  if(pb)pb.style.width=(clamp(scL/Math.max(1,docH-innerHeight),0,1)*100)+'%';
  if(navB)navB.classList.toggle('sc',scL>10);
  const wide=W>=900;
  cx=wide?W*.7:W*.5;cy=wide?H*.5:H*.68;
  u=Math.min(W*(wide?.17:.3),H*(wide?.22:.15))*(1+.015*Math.sin(t*1.5));
  if(t>nextAuto){pulses.push({x:cx,y:cy,t0:t});nextAuto=t+6}
  pulses=pulses.filter(p=>{const a=t-p.t0;p.R=a*u*2.4;p.f=1-a/1.9;return p.f>0});
  const sweep=Math.sin(t*.8)*.9;
  const cs=Math.cos(sw),ss=Math.sin(sw),cp=Math.cos(pit),sp=Math.sin(pit);
  for(const [x,y,z,s] of CORE){
    // rotated normal for light
    const nx=x*cs+z*ss,nz1=-x*ss+z*cs,ny=y*cp-nz1*sp,nz=y*sp+nz1*cp;
    let b=.24+.55*Math.max(0,nx*L[0]+ny*L[1]+nz*L[2])+.12*nz;
    b+=.55*Math.exp(-((ny-sweep)*(ny-sweep))/.02);
    plot(x*s,y*s,z*s,b);
  }
  for(const g of RINGS){
    const cr=Math.cos(g.tx),sr=Math.sin(g.tx),cz=Math.cos(g.tz),sz=Math.sin(g.tz);
    for(let j=0;j<g.n;j++){
      if(Math.sin(j*.9)>.55)continue;
      const a=j/g.n*TAU+t*g.sp;
      let x=g.R*Math.cos(a),y=0,z=g.R*Math.sin(a);
      let y1=y*cr-z*sr,z1=y*sr+z*cr;z=z1;y=y1;
      const x2=x*cz-y*sz,y3=x*sz+y*cz;
      const r=plot(x2,y3,z,.42,1);
      if(r)gi[Math.floor((cy-r[1]*u*6/(6-r[2]))/ch)*cols+Math.floor((cx+r[0]*u*6/(6-r[2]))/cw)]+=.35*(r[2]/g.R);
    }
  }
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  if(bg){ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.drawImage(bg,0,0,W,H)}
  ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.font=fs+'px "JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  for(const i of act)bk[i]=clamp(Math.floor(gi[i]*NB),1,NB);
  for(let k=1;k<=NB;k++){
    ctx.fillStyle=pal[k];const gch=GL[k];
    for(const i of act)if(bk[i]===k)ctx.fillText(gch,((i%cols)+.5)*cw,(Math.floor(i/cols)+.5)*ch);
  }
  for(const i of act)zb[i]=-9;
  act.length=0;ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

/* input: drag rotates, a quick click sends a pulse */
addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
  if(e.target!==cv||e.button>0)return;
  drag=true;lx=e.clientX;ly=e.clientY;trav=0;vy=vp=0;
});
addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
  if(!drag)return;
  const dx=e.clientX-lx,dy=e.clientY-ly;lx=e.clientX;ly=e.clientY;trav+=Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy);
  yaw+=dx*.009;pit=clamp(pit+dy*.009,-1.2,1.2);
  vy=clamp(dx*.35,-6,6);vp=clamp(dy*.35,-4,4);
});
function up(e){
  if(!drag)return;drag=false;
  if(trav<8){pulses.push({x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,t0:t});vy=vp=0}
}
addEventListener('pointerup',up);
addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>{drag=false});
addEventListener('resize',layout);
matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').addEventListener('change',theme);

/* page behaviour */
document.querySelectorAll('[data-go]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const target=$(b.dataset.go); if(target) target.scrollIntoView({behavior:RM?'auto':'smooth'});
}));
const toast=$('toast'),pb=$('pb'),navB=document.querySelector('.nav');let tt;
document.querySelectorAll('[data-dl]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(!toast)return;
  toast.textContent='Download link not configured yet. Add your release URL to enable downloads.';
  toast.classList.add('on');clearTimeout(tt);tt=setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('on'),2800);
}));

/* smooth scroll reveal + image fade-in */
const io=('IntersectionObserver'in window)?new IntersectionObserver(es=>{let k=0;for(const e of es)if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.style.setProperty('--d',(k++*.08).toFixed(2)+'s');e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target)}},{threshold:0,rootMargin:'0px 0px -7% 0px'}):null;
document.querySelectorAll('.rv').forEach(el=>io?io.observe(el):el.classList.add('in'));
document.querySelectorAll('.shot img').forEach(im=>{const ok=()=>im.classList.add('ld');im.complete&&im.naturalWidth?ok():im.addEventListener('load',ok,{once:true})});

/* typed demo */
const D=[
  ['open the invoice from Tuesday','Example response: I can look for a matching file if file search is configured.'],
  ['rename these 48 photos by date','Example response: I can prepare a rename plan for you to review.'],
  ['summarize this PDF in 5 bullets','Example response: Add a readable PDF and a compatible model to summarize it.'],
  ['quiet mode until 3pm','Example response: This needs a configured focus-mode tool and timer.']
];
const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));
async function typeTo(el,s,ms){el.textContent='';for(const c of s){el.textContent+=c;await sleep(ms)}}
async function demo(){
  const qq=$('qq'),aa=$('aa');
  if(RM){qq.textContent=D[0][0];aa.textContent=D[0][1];return}
  for(;;)for(const [q,a] of D){
    aa.textContent='';await typeTo(qq,q,45);await sleep(450);await typeTo(aa,a,14);await sleep(2400);
  }
}
demo();

layout();theme();
if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.load)document.fonts.load('400 14px "JetBrains Mono"').then(()=>{layout()}).catch(()=>{});
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
